entries.zh: 自渎、手淫（天主教神学语「自愿遗泄」之罪）；汉字作隐语「打鸟铳」
entries.en: voluntary pollution; masturbation (moral-theology term; the Chinese is a bawdy euphemism, lit. 'to fire the bird-gun')
to sway, swing, rock; to waver (Spanish headword obscure)
entries.notes: 词头'pompear el vano'非规范17世纪西语且有[疑:vano/vanc]，据汉字'搖擺'与 M 'yō pày'定为摇摆义。

entries.zh: 摇摇摆摆、摇晃不定（叠字形式）
entries.en: to sway back and forth, rock repeatedly (reduplicated form; Spanish headword obscure)
entries.notes: 同上条，词头讹且有[疑:vano/vans]，据叠字'搖〻擺〻'与 M 'yō yō pày pày'定释义。

entries.en: to ponder, weigh in the mind, estimate; to consider
entries.notes: 汉字'度'取忖度义；M 栏读音有[疑:tôy/tō]，故中等置信。

entries.zh: 斟；思量、斟酌〔词头西文残讹难解，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to ponder by deliberating; to pour out and weigh 〔headword garbled; gloss provisional〕
entries.notes: 词头'af cuyidandv dello. gomodohit'讹乱难解（仅可辨 cuydando＝思虑），汉字有[疑:甚/基]，仅据 M 'chīm'（斟）推断。

entries.zh: 斟酌；思虑权衡、细细考量
entries.en: to deliberate, to weigh carefully; to consider thoughtfully

entries.zh: 识时势；审时度势、明察事势
entries.en: to discern the times and circumstances; to judge a situation rightly (to ponder matters)

entries.zh: 识轻重；权衡轻重、知孰轻孰重
entries.en: to know what is light and what is heavy; to judge the relative importance of things

entries.zh: 格物；推究事物之理（《大学》「格物致知」之义）
entries.en: to investigate things (gewu; after the Great Learning's 'investigation of things')

entries.notes: 词头有[残:涂改]，汉字栏空白，M 四音节无法还原为可信汉字；残存西文或为 reprehender（责难）但不足为据。

entries.zh: 毒；毒物（自本条起为毒物系列词条）
entries.notes: 词头'sonuna'当为 ponçoña（旧拼 ponzoña，毒）之讹读；据汉字'毒'、M 'tâg: tôg'两读及其后 ponçoña 毒物系列互证。

entries.zh: 毒物；首字[疑:嗫/喋]未定，或为以口就毒之义
entries.en: venom, poison (first character uncertain, prob. a mouth-radical char 嗫/喋)
entries.notes: 首字[疑:嗫/喋]不能定，M 仅存'tâu'一音难以对应，据词头 ponçoña 系列与'毒'字定为毒物义。

entries.zh: 癫狂、疯（疑为「瘋狂」；毒物系列中或指疯犬之毒）
entries.en: madness, insanity (prob. 瘋狂 'mad'); in the venom-series context, possibly the poison of a rabid dog
entries.notes: 两字均带[疑:癈/瘢][疑:廣/狂]，据 M 'cong'（狂）与毒物系列语境推断为'瘋狂'义。

entries.zh: 马蜞、水蛭（蚂蟥）；吸血之虫
entries.en: leech, bloodsucking worm (a ponçoña venom-series item)
entries.notes: 字有[疑:蜞/槌]，但 M 'bē chȳ'与'馬蜞'相应，闽语即称蚂蟥；词头'de mafrosa'一节未解。

entries.zh: 毒药；（M 栏旁注 medicina）药物、药剂
entries.en: poison, venomous drug; medicine (Spanish marginal note 'medicina')
entries.notes: M 栏'tôg iô'之后另注西语'medicina'，示'毒藥'兼摄毒与药二义。

entries.zh: 溃起；（疮毒）溃烂隆起、发作
entries.en: to fester and break out, to ulcerate (of venomous sores)

entries.zh: 放；放置、搁放（poner）；放下、留在某处（dejar en alguna parte）
entries.en: to put, to place; to leave (something) in a place
to put, to place; to situate oneself (ponerse)
entries.notes: M 栏'bŷ'与汉字'置'的对音不合，疑为转写讹误；释义据西语 poner 与'置'字互证。
